blocks.text: The building management office has told us that the lobby doors will be on card access only from tomorrow evening through the end of the holiday weekend, and when I compared our staff list with theirs this afternoon, your card was among the older ones that the new readers no longer recognize. I would not want you to arrive at a locked door if you plan to come in while the front desk is unstaffed.

The replacement is straightforward, although it must be done in person: the management office on the ground floor will reissue the card while you wait, provided you bring your current card and a photo ID. Could you let me know by the end of today whether you are able to stop by tomorrow before they close, so that I can tell them to expect you?
